# SmartSpectra SDK

- [Getting Started](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs): Set up your API key and integrate the SmartSpectra SDK in your app.
- Android: undefined
  - [Quick Start](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/android): Get started with the SmartSpectra Android SDK — Kotlin, min SDK 28.
  - [Option 1: API Key](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/android/option-1-api-key): Fast manual SmartSpectra Android setup using an API key.
  - [Option 2: OAuth](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/android/option-2-oauth): SmartSpectra Android setup using OAuth instead of a hard-coded API key.
  - [Configuring Metrics](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/android/metrics): Request and read SmartSpectra metrics from the Android SDK.
  - [Headless Mode](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/android/headless-mode): Wire SmartSpectra SDK lifecycle and metrics LiveData into your own Android UI — useful for background monitoring or custom interfaces.
  - [Migration Guide](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/android/migration-guide): Android-specific migration notes for SmartSpectra SDK upgrades.
  - [API Reference](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/android/api-reference): API Reference for the SmartSpectra SDK.
  - [Troubleshooting](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/android/troubleshooting): Solutions to common build, runtime, and integration issues with the SmartSpectra Android SDK.
- Swift: undefined
  - [Quick Start](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/swift): Get started with the SmartSpectra Swift SDK for iOS — iOS 17+.
  - [Option 1: API Key](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/swift/option-1-api-key): Fast manual SmartSpectra Swift setup using an API key.
  - [Option 2: OAuth](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/swift/option-2-oauth): SmartSpectra Swift setup using OAuth instead of a hard-coded API key.
  - [Configuring Metrics](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/swift/metrics): Request and read SmartSpectra metrics from the Swift SDK.
  - [Headless Mode](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/swift/headless-mode): Drive SmartSpectra SDK observable state directly from your own iOS UI — useful for background monitoring or custom interfaces.
  - [Migration Guide](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/swift/migration-guide): Migration notes for SmartSpectra Swift SDK upgrades.
  - [Use Case Examples](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/swift/use-case-examples): Example SmartSpectra Swift integration patterns for common app use cases.
  - [API Reference](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/swift/api-reference): API Reference for the SmartSpectra SDK.
  - [Troubleshooting](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/swift/troubleshooting): Solutions to common build, runtime, and integration issues with the SmartSpectra Swift SDK.
- C++: undefined
  - [C++ SDK](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/cpp): Get started with SmartSpectra C++ across Linux, macOS, and Windows.
  - C++ on Linux: undefined
    - [Overview](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/cpp/linux): Install the SmartSpectra C++ SDK on Ubuntu and Linux Mint. Pick the guide that matches your distribution.
    - [Ubuntu 22.04 / Mint 21](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/cpp/linux/ubuntu-22-04): Install the SmartSpectra C++ SDK on Ubuntu 22.04 or Linux Mint 21 (jammy) for amd64 and arm64.
    - [Ubuntu 24.04 / Mint 22](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/cpp/linux/ubuntu-24-04): Install the SmartSpectra C++ SDK on Ubuntu 24.04 or Linux Mint 22 (noble) for amd64 and arm64.
  - [C++ on macOS](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/cpp/macos): Install the SmartSpectra C++ SDK and run the SwiftUI macOS sample app.
  - C++ on Windows: undefined
    - [C++ on Windows](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/cpp/windows): Install and build the SmartSpectra C++ SDK on Windows.
    - [C++ on Windows (NuGet)](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/cpp/windows/windows-nuget): NuGet install path for the SmartSpectra C++ SDK on Windows — suitable for Visual Studio and MSBuild projects.
    - [.NET on Windows](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/cpp/windows/windows-dotnet): SmartSpectra.Net — C# / .NET 8 wrapper for the SmartSpectra SDK on Windows.
    - [Issues and Limitations](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/cpp/windows/issues-and-limitations): Known issues and limitations for the SmartSpectra C++ SDK on Windows.
  - [Configuring Metrics](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/cpp/metrics): Request and read SmartSpectra metrics from the C++ SDK.
  - [Headless Mode](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/cpp/headless-mode): The SmartSpectra C++ SDK is headless by default — wire up metric and frame callbacks for custom integrations.
  - [Migration Guide](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/cpp/migration-guide): C++-specific migration notes for SmartSpectra SDK upgrades.
  - [API Reference](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/cpp/api-reference): API Reference for the SmartSpectra SDK.
- Node.js: undefined
  - [Node.js SDK](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/nodejs): Build Node.js apps — including Electron desktop apps — with SmartSpectra via a packaged native runtime loaded through koffi.
  - [Configuring Metrics](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/nodejs/metrics): Request and read SmartSpectra metrics from the Node.js SDK.
  - [API Reference](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/nodejs/api-reference): API Reference for the SmartSpectra SDK.
- **Reference**

- [Model Cards and Limitations](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/model-cards-and-limitations): Model cards, operating ranges, and known limitations for SmartSpectra SDK metrics.
- [Data Types](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/data-types): Data Types for the SmartSpectra SDK.
- **Shipping Your App**

- [Redistribute on Linux](https://docs.physiology.presagetech.com/docs/redistribute_smartspectra_on_linux): Bundle the SmartSpectra Linux C++ SDK tarball into your own .deb so end users install your app on stock Ubuntu without a Presage apt source.
